ops.$comment: [P4.D146 / v4 70505745a] The READ side of the retired-mode coercion. A project stored in 'static' — the shape a pre-4.9 instance is full of, and one that the post-fix create can no longer produce — is planted on disk here, then touched with an unrelated patch. The write overlay's read-modify-write seeds from the parsed bag, so the value that lands back on disk is the NORMALIZED 'theme'. (Alpha's create carries 'project' and covers the WRITE side: the retired value never reaches disk at all.)
ops.label: zeta

ops.$comment: [P4.D246 / v4 9753d0eb2] The repository's CREATE seed, `allowAnyCharacter ?? true`, on its null arm: v4's `prepareCreateData` runs BEFORE the entity is validated and `??` treats an explicit null as absent, so a create carrying `allowAnyCharacter: null` lands OPEN. (The API refuses a null at the schema, so only a repository caller — import, restore, a fixture builder — can reach this arm.) Measured at the pin: v4's create accepts it.
ops.label: eta

ops.$comment: [P4.D246 / v4 9753d0eb2] The READ default, pinned directly: a stored bag MISSING `allowAnyCharacter` (the shape a pre-flip store or a hand-edited one carries) is planted on disk, then touched with an unrelated patch. The write overlay's read-modify-write seeds from the PARSED bag, so the value that lands back on disk is the schema's read default — `false` — and NOT the create seed's `true`. v4's `ProjectPropertiesSchema.default(false)` did not move at `9753d0eb2`; only the two create-time defaults did. (Epsilon's deleteProperties-then-update is the other, indirect pin of the same rule.)
ops.label: theta

ops.$comment: [P4.146 / dogfood #136] (a)+(b) The finding's reference case widened to all eleven `.nullable().optional()` keys: a cutover-shaped v4 bag (every NULL column an explicit null) is planted, then ONLY allowAnyCharacter is toggled. v4's Zod parse keeps every null through the read-modify-write, so the stored bytes (and so the file's sha) differ from the planted bytes in that ONE key.
